name: Brusselator Chemical Oscillator
description: The Brusselator is a theoretical model for an autocatalytic chemical reaction showing oscillatory behavior. Developed by Ilya Prigogine and colleagues as a simplified model of Belousov-Zhabotinsky type reactions. Reference: Strogatz, S. H. (2015). Nonlinear Dynamics and Chaos. Westview Press. Source: https://doi.org/10.1201/9780429492563
reference: Prigogine I, Lefever R. Symmetry Breaking Instabilities in Dissipative Systems. II. J Chem Phys. 1968;48(4):1695-1700.

flows.name: dX/dt
